item.title: Leaves and litter in the street for over a year, 14th November
item.description:
Leaves have been building up in the street - across drains. I feel like they haven’t been cleared for several years - there is a thick layer of mulch on pavement and outside that garage. Amongst the leaves are a rotting fence post and two heavy carrier bags full of debris This is outside brandlings (last house on the left). The lime tree is not in our garden. Lime trees border our property and there is already a lot of leaf maintenance required on my property. It seems the council should deal with the leaf fall in the street which has been neglected for years. It would be good if the rubbish which is amongst it could also be removed. Recently we were trying to cut our hedge. It has become very difficult to clear up/sweep the pavement because of the thick leaf mulch on the pavement. It seems it may require some spade work.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cyril Road, Goddington, Greater London
